TEST CHART FOR BORING AND MILLING MACHINES WITH HORIZONTAL SPINDLE
PART 1 TABLE TYPE MACHINES

1. Scope - Describes both geometrical and practical machines with horizontal spindle and the corresponding IS : 2063-1962 `Code for testing machine tools'.

tests on Table type boring permissible deviations with

and milling reference to

1.1 It deals only with the verification of accuracy and applies neither to the testing of running of the machine ( vibrations, abnormal noises, stick-slip motion of components, etc ) nor to the machine characteristics ( speeds, feeds, etc ) which shall generally be checked before testing the accuracy. 1.2 It also machines. includes complementary geometrical and practical tests in respect of rotary table

Note - It should be noted that this standard concerns machines which have both longitudinal movement of the table, and may include a rotary or indexing table. It will also have a vertical spindle head, and possibly a facing head. 2. Preliminary Remarks

and transverse movement of the

2.1 To apply these tests, reference shall be made to IS : 2063-1962 especially for installation of the machine before testing, warming up of spindles and other moving parts, description of measuring methods and recommended accuracy of testing equipment. 2.2 The sequence in which the geometrical tests are given is related to the sub-assemblies of the machine and does not define the practical order of testing. In order to make checking or mounting of instruments easier, tests may be carried out in any convenient sequence. 2.3 When inspecting a machine, it is necessary to carry out all the, tests described In this standard, excepting those tests which may be omitted in mutual agreement between the buyer and the manufacturer. 2.4 When establishing the tolerance for a measuring range different from that indicated in this standard ( see 2.3.1.1 of IS : 2063-1962 ), it shall be taken into consideration that the minimum tolerance is 0'002 5 mm. 2.5 Whenever alternate methods is left to the manufacturer. of testing are suggested, the choice of actual method of testing are

2.6 For the purpose of this standard, various methods of expressing permissible deviation employed, each having a particular type of application. The methods employed are as follows: OOO/OOO for deviations of perpendicularity which are ratios.

000 for any length of 000 for deviations of straightness and parallelism; this expression used in fact for local permissible deviations, the measuring length being obligatory.

is

000 for 000 for deviations of straightness and parallelism; this expression is used to recommend a measuring length but in this case the proportionality rule comes into operation if the measuring length differs from those indicated. 3. Testing Instruments - The testing instruments shall be of the approved type and shall calibrated at a recognized temperature conforming to the relevant Indian Standards. be

required, the maximum 4. Accuracy Requirements - The tests to be carried out, the instruments permissible deviations and the manner of carrying out the tests shall be as detailed in the test chart.

Reference to IS : 20631962 and/or Instruction for Testing ~.__ y (5) PROCEDURE Before lying the fixture on the table, make sure that the axis of rotation of the table is situated exactly in the vertical plane through the boring spindle axis, then lock the table base in its slideways Arrange the mounting on the table so that its centring C coincides exactly with the axis of rotation of the table possibly using a centring mandrel M Swivel the mounting on the table, setting the reference block Ri and Rn in a vertical plane through the boring spindle axis Lock the mounting on the table and assemble the test pieces as shown on the diagram Finish boring to the diameter d of the first test pieces with axial movement of the boring spindle ?otate the table by 180" and bore the second test piece similarly
Note - Except for the rotation of the table and the rotation of the boring spindle, all the other parts of the machine shali be locked during this test

NOTE

standard is generally based on IS0 3070/l-1975 `Test conditions for boring and milting of accuracy: Part I Table type machines' and with horizontal spindle - Testing 1-1976 `Complementary geometrical tests and practical tests to be specified in the case for Standardization ( IS0 ). table machines' issued by International Organization in case of spindle head, permissible variation values specified for geometrical test 10, 11, 12 and practical test numbers.
